items.prompt:
A digital signal usually uses which values?
A) 0s and 1s
B) Smooth curves only
C) Colors
D) Letters A-Z

An analog signal varies:
A) In separate steps
B) Smoothly and continuously
C) Only as 0s and 1s
D) Never

steps: Analog signals change smoothly and continuously.

items.prompt:
Which type of signal is generally more reliable?
A) Analog
B) Digital
C) Neither
D) Both equally

A song stored as a stream of 0s and 1s is a:
A) Analog signal
B) Digital signal
C) Sound wave only
D) Mechanical wave

steps: Coding information as 0s and 1s is digital.

items.prompt:
Why does a digital photo stay clear after many copies?
A) It uses smooth curves
B) Its 0s and 1s can be copied exactly and errors corrected
C) It cannot be copied
D) It loses quality each time
items.answer: B) Its 0s and 1s can be copied exactly and errors corrected

steps: Digital values can be copied exactly, keeping quality.

items.prompt:
Why does an old analog tape lose quality when copied?
A) Digital errors
B) Analog signals degrade a little with each copy
C) It uses 0s and 1s
D) It is too reliable
items.answer: B) Analog signals degrade a little with each copy

steps: Continuous analog signals lose quality when copied.

items.prompt:
Which signal would best survive being sent over a long, noisy distance, and why?
A) Analog, because it is smooth
B) Digital, because errors can be corrected to the nearest 0 or 1
C) Analog, because it has no values
D) Neither can be sent far
items.answer: B) Digital, because errors can be corrected to the nearest 0 or 1

steps: Digital signals correct noise by snapping to 0 or 1, so they survive better.

items.prompt:
The main reason modern devices use digital signals is that they:
A) Look nicer
B) Encode and transmit information more reliably with less loss
C) Are always analog
D) Cannot store music
items.answer: B) Encode and transmit information more reliably with less loss

steps: Digital signals are a more reliable way to encode and transmit information.
